All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary of our review:

**Deviations (2) — redlines proposed:**

1. **LOL-CAP (critical)** — §21.1's mutual cap is pegged to "Fees," which §§1.5–1.6 define as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form. The cap is therefore effectively USD 12,000 — illusory. We reset the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000. Mutuality, the damages exclusion, and the Excluded Claims carve-outs in §21.3 (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP) are all acceptable as drafted.

2. **LD (high)** — §7.7 imposes liquidated damages on us of 15% of annual Fees per week of late payment: punitive, aggregate-unlimited, and inconsistent with our §7.3 right to withhold disputed amounts. Deleted, with simple interest on undisputed overdue amounts offered as a fallback.

**Compliant (16):** INDEMN, NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN (runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT, MINCOMMIT, T4C (30 days via §29.4, pro-rata refund, no Vendor convenience right), RENEWAL, GOVLAW (NY law and courts), ASSIGN, IP, LICENSE, AUDIT, WARRANTY, INSURANCE, TRANSITION.

Notably, §12.3 is a helpful catch-all confirming we have given no exclusivity, non-compete, MFN, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment — worth preserving in any counter-draft.
